messages.subject: Re: Upload folder that contains shared R code and images between shiny projects
parts: All files to be deployed must be within the application directory hierarchy. You could try accomplishing what you want by creating a symlink within the application directory to the directory containing the shared code, but I haven't tested to see if that works or not.
